newsitem.title: UK: Dry cargo still busy, ongoing shortage in US Gulf.
newsitem.headline: Dry cargo still busy, ongoing shortage in US Gulf.

text.p: Despite today's holiday in Japan and the imminent Christmas break conditions in the dry cargo market have been quite active.
Brokers reported a continuing shortage of early tonnage for loading grain in the US Gulf, but slightly softer rates for Panamaxes in the North Pacific.
The Caper market was quiet while Handy-sizes demand was strong in North and South America but weaker elsewhere. The BFI was unchanged at 1523.
GRAIN - Reports of Capers fixed for US Gulf/Holland could not be verified.

The strength of the early Panamax market in the US Gulf was underlined by Skydragon's fixture of Irene 65,000 dwt delivery retro sailing Greece Dec 11 trip via US Gulf to China at $16,450 daily - vessel will arrive to load before the end of the month.
But Continental's fixture of North Princess to cover 54,000 heavy grain Nopac/Japan for Jan 5/15 at $11,250 daily plus $200,000 bonus was regarded by brokers as a relatively weak.

Handies in the Atlantic continued to prosper in the grain trades - Bluedeck are said to have taken at least 3 vessels for end Dec/early Jan loading US Gulf for trips to Egypt at solid rates in the region of $8,000 daily plus $100,000 bonus.
These charterers are still looking for both Panamax and Handy tonnage to load in the uS Gulf for Egypt.
Romac took the 20-year old Alpha 28,193 dwt delivery spot Gibraltar for a trip via the Plate to Mombasa wi redelivery passing Durban at a firm $7,400 daily.

Euro Liberty 27,000 dwt was rumoured fixed on subjects from the Plate, possibly to Iran. In addition to fixing Eleranta and Doric Chariot for Dec/Jan loading 60,000 wheat W.Australia/Nava Sheva at $16.75, the Indian government has fixed 2 handy-sizes for similar business on private terms.
New orders quoted today included Geepee 25/35,000 dwt delivery US Gulf Jan 8/15 trip Red Sea/Arabian Gulf and Copenship 26,500 min/max wheat Dunkirk/Hodeidah for Dec 25/30.

MINERALS - Little was heard of mineral trades business. Abant 105,000 dwt failed with Deiulemar for a Transatlantic round with coal to Turkey and these charterers fixed instead Iolcos Pioneer 131,260 dwt delivery and redelivery Passero at $8,000 daily.
In the Panamax size President G 69,344 dwt is rumoured fixed for S.African coal.

Western Trade 65,083 dwt has been booked on subjects by Panocean delivery Jakarta mid Jan for 3-5 months at close to $11,250 daily Athena 60,500 dwt agreed $10,400 daily with Keoyang delivery Sri Lanka early Jan for 3-5 months but failed on subjects.

HANDIES - The gearless Chusuvoy 35,000 dwt failed on subjects with UBT for a trip from the Baltic to the US Gulf at $5,600 daily, and Taxiarhis P 39,013 dwt open prompt Norway has been fixed on subjects (possibly account Fednav).

In the East Comshipco chartered Efessos 34,273 dwt from Dampier to S.Africa in the high $4,000's daily and these charterers also fixed Ccalypso N 33,000 dwt on voyage basis on private terms with ilmenite from Bunbury to Immingham.
